20 [[Kilogram/Legends|kg]]''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' |cargohandling= |consumables=1 [[Standard day/Legends|day]] |lifesupport= |communications= |othersystems= |availability=Restricted |role=*Cavalry *Reconnaissance |firstuse= |retired= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]{{Film|III}} *[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] *[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]''[[Galaxy at War]]'' **[[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]] *Fringe elements{{GalaxiesAED}} }} {{Quote|Most impressive is the AT-RT, yes?|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''}} The '''All Terrain Recon Transport''' ('''AT-RT''') was a one-man bipedal [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used for reconnaissance and patrolling, first by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and later on by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]''[[Star Wars: Lethal Alliance]]''''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was made by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:AT-RT-TCW.png|thumb|left|200px|An [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF trooper]] on an AT-RT.]] One of several precursors to the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST walker]], the AT-RT was 3.2 meters tall and 2.9 meters long, with a saddle-like seat for a single [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[AT-RT driver|driver]]. Its open cockpit design made the driver especially vulnerable to [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] fire, a notable flaw, but low costs and good visibility of the battlefield made up for this shortcoming. While other walkers like the [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]] eliminated the flaw of the exposed driver position, the AT-PT was slower, and this made the AT-RT competitive with the former as it was capable of tremendous speeds and could also leap quite a distance thanks to its light construction.''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' The recon walker was equipped with a nose-mounted [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannon]] and [[Mortar/Legends|mortar]] launcher,''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' both of which made the walker a formidable anti-infantry unit, although a group of five walkers could easily overpower a single [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]]. The AT-RT was fitted with a motion detection scanner and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] equipment capable of providing [[Forward Command Center/Legends|Forward Command Centers]] with updated situation reports from the battlefield. AT-RTs could be deployed to the battle field in various ways. They were usually deployed from landed [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], but this wasn't always practical for size reasons. When this occurred, they could be deployed by [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/is]], 1 per gunship stored on the speeder bike ramp, 2 could be carried if the crew bay was empty.{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}} The walkers could also be deployed from modified AT-TEs with special cargo lifts in their back section. They could transport 2 Walkers and their riders. [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF Troopers]] were known to pilot these walkers.{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}} ==History== [[File:Cazne_ruins.png|thumb|left|250px|AT-RTs [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|used by]] the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].]] Due to its light construction, AT-RT walkers were especially vulnerable to heavy weapons. This led many commanders to use them in fast scout packs, such as [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], a team that consisted of ten ARF troopers specially trained to operate AT-RTs. They were also used in the role of civilian (police or militia) support. Commonly, these walkers operated as picket and pathfinder units.{{DB|vehicle|atrt|All Terrain Recon Transport (AT-RT walker)}} AT-RT walkers were used on several worlds during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], three AT-RTs made a gallant charge into the advancing enemy lines, 2 were destroyed, and it is unknown if the last walker and it's rider returned. Prior to the battle, they were stored in the Republics forwards command center, but many were destroyed when the traitorous clone trooper [[Slick/Legends|Slick]] sabotaged the base. In the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], AT-TEs got trapped on ridge by [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] firing at their position. Mace Windu ordered the deployment of Lighting Squad. The squad and their walkers were deployed from specially adapted AT-TE with lifts in their rear section. Led by [[Mace Windu/Legends|General Windu]], the squad advanced on the enemy tanks, the walkers were too fast for the tanks and outflanked them easily, which allowed Lightning to attack the tanks from behind targeting their weak spots. [[File:Battle_of_Ryloth.jpg|thumb|right|250px|AT-RTs take on an AAT]] Shortly after the skirmish, Windu took two Advanced Recon Force troopers, Razor and Stak, to Cazne to find the freedom fighters of Ryloth, after encountering a droid patrol they met up with [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]], the leader of the resistance. After the leader of the resistance agreed with Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] to ally themselves with the Republic forces, the Syndulla and Windu came up with a plan to take the occupied city of Lessu. Mace Windu stowed away inside an [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTT]] headed for the City, as they were crossing the bridge, however, they were detected by the Droids. The Jedi made a break for the end of the bridge while AT-RTs and AT-TEs along with the Ryloth Resistance provided cover fire from the ridge over-looking the bridge. After fighting off the droids, the force made its way across the bridge, the AT-RTs took out the Tank guard then made their way into the city. In the [[Battle of Kiros]], AT-RTs were deployed by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]]. These were later used by Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano to find the bombs hidden around the city. After defeating the droids guarding each bomb, they managed to disarm them. [[File:AT-RTs-Umbara.jpg|right|250px|AT-RTs on Umbara.]] Many AT-RTs of the 501st were deployed on [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] when trying to capture the capital city. When beginning their assault on the surface, the walkers were launched from the back of LAAT/is. The walkers were ideal for the rough, uneven terrain of the planet, and because of their size could move through the thick forested areas with relative ease. However, they were no match for the hi-tech armaments of the Umbaran separatists, and were easy pickings for the likes of the [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|Umbaran hover tank]]. [[File:ATRT-SWTCG.png|thumb|left|250px|AT-RT drivers patrolling on Kashyyyk]] As with the Umbaran Campaign, great numbers of these walkers were deployed for [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], and were later used in an attempt to track down [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. They also saw action on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planets such as the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|conflicts]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and [[Battle of Mygeeto|Mygeeto]]. Units of this type were also used during the [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|Battle of Rishi]]. These light-weight walkers would also be utilized in the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Over a year later, during an attempt by ex-Jedi [[Fy-Tor-Ana]] and [[Ferus Olin]] to retrieve a cache of lightsabers from the occupied Temple, AT-RTs would back up teams of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that were hunting them. However, it appeared that the AT-RT was phased out in favor of the AT-ST. Nonetheless, it was considered preferable to the [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]], especially by various notable scouting units. According to the Imperial-turned-Rebel General [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], the AT-RT was commonly used in police units, and was easy to steal them on most Rim worlds. Elite Imperial units like [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] continued to utilize their AT-RTs during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Modified AT-RTs were also utilized by the Rebel Alliance and fringe groups. Many of these walkers were painted with camouflage to better blend in with their surroundings. A floodlight often replaced the repeating blaster cannon, providing additional aid for the walker on night-time missions, but making the vehicle more vulnerable in the process. ==Behind the scenes== The script for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] refers to this single-man walker as a modified scout walker. Designed by [[T.J. Frame]], it was to be part of an extended scene where [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] distracts some mutinous clone troopers by acting like a crazy hermit. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] would have then climbed up the back of the walker and removed the pilot, in a move very similar to his boarding of the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. The scene was [[Content cut from Star Wars|ultimately cut out]]. Animation Supervisor [[Rob Coleman]] had his team of animators closely studied the stop-motion animation of the scout walkers in the original trilogy, so they could digitally recreate some of the
